table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = (dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),     
		 CustomerRef = max(convert(int ,rtrim(ltrim(IsNull(dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, '0'))))), 
       date = max(dbo.saleledger.date), 
		 invdiscperc = max(dbo.saleledger.discperc),    
       flatdisc = max(dbo.saleledger.flatdisc), 
       misccharges = max(dbo.saleledger.misccharges), 
       invsalestax = max(dbo.saleledger.salestax),
       remarks = (dbo.saleledger.remarks), 
       custcode = max(dbo.saleledger.custcode),
		 looseqty = sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
		 packqty  = max(saledetail.packqty),  
		   price = max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice),  
		itemdiscperc=max(saledetail.discperc),  
       unittax=max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
		 taxamount= max(saledetail.unitsalestax) * sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		itemtotal=sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty) *((max(dbo.saledetail.saleprice) - max(saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - 0.01*max(saledetail.discperc))),
		 itemdiscperc = max(dbo.saledetail.discperc),
		    
		 packunits = max(dbo.saledetail.packunits),    
		 batch = max(dbo.saledetail.batch),    
		 expiry = max(dbo.saledetail.expiry),    
		 salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),
		 rowid     = max(saledetail.rowid),
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 Person = (dbo.accounts.name),
		 contactperson=(dbo.customer.cp),
		 address = (dbo.customer.address1),
		 city = (dbo.customer.city)

FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.accounts,
		 dbo.Customer
		 

WHERE  dbo.saleledger.originaldate >= :ad_StartDate and
		 	dbo.saleledger.originaldate <= :ad_EndDate  and 
			dbo.saleledger.custcode = :al_CustCode and 
			 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode 

Group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
		saledetail.icode,
		item.name,
		(dbo.accounts.name),
		(dbo.customer.cp),
		(dbo.customer.address1),
		(dbo.customer.city),
		(dbo.saleledger.remarks)
UNION ALL
SELECT saleinvcode = (dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),    
		 CustomerRef = max(convert(int ,rtrim(ltrim(IsNull(dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, '0'))))),
       date = max(dbo.saleledger.date), 
		 invdiscperc = max(dbo.saleledger.discperc),    
       flatdisc = max(dbo.saleledger.flatdisc), 
       misccharges = max(dbo.saleledger.misccharges), 
       invsalestax = max(dbo.saleledger.salestax),
       remarks = (dbo.saleledger.remarks), 
       custcode = max(dbo.saleledger.custcode),
		 looseqty = sum(sd.looseqty), 
		 packqty  = 0,  
		 price = max(sd.saleprice),   
		itemdiscperc=max(sd.discperc), 
       unittax=max(sd.unitsalestax),
		 taxamount= max(sd.unitsalestax) * sum(sd.looseqty),
		itemtotal=sum(sd.looseqty) *((max(sd.saleprice) - max(sd.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - 0.01*max(sd.discperc))),
		 itemdiscperc = max(sd.discperc),    
		 packunits = max(sd.packunits),    
		 batch = max(sd.batch),    
		 expiry = max(sd.expiry),    
		 salestax  = 0,
		 rowid     = max(sd.rowid),
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 Person = (dbo.accounts.name),
		 contactperson=(dbo.customer.cp),
		 address = (dbo.customer.address1),
		 city = (dbo.customer.city)

FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saleinvdetail sd, 
		 dbo.item, 
		 dbo.accounts,
		 dbo.Customer
		

WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
		 dbo.saleledger.originaldate >= :ad_StartDate and
		 dbo.saleledger.originaldate <= :ad_EndDate  and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode =:al_custcode and 
		  dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		 sd.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode 
		 
Group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
		sd.icode,
		item.name,
		(dbo.accounts.name),
		(dbo.customer.cp),
		(dbo.customer.address1),
		(dbo.customer.city),
		(dbo.saleledger.remarks)
ORDER BY
	CustomerRef,
	rowid
